blocks.orig: Exploring all that Tanzania has to offer is a dream for many. From epic Tanzania safari adventures spotting Africa’s Big Five, to climbing Kilimanjaro or relaxing on the paradise beaches of Zanzibar: Tanzania has it all. Good news: Your Tanzania Trip can build a custom made itinerary that suits all your wishes.
blocks.html: Many people dream of discovering everything Tanzania has to offer. Think of an epic Tanzania safari in search of Africa’s Big Five, a climb up Kilimanjaro or lazy days on the paradise beaches of Zanzibar: you will find it all in Tanzania. The good news is that Your Tanzania Trip can put together a custom made itinerary that matches all your wishes.

blocks.orig: Our most popular itineraries can help you find some inspiration. Most of our clients love to end their exciting safari with a few days of relaxation on one of Zanzibar’s most stunning beaches. Would you like that as well?
blocks.html: For inspiration, take a look at our most popular itineraries. After an exciting safari, most of our clients like to unwind for a few days on one of the most stunning beaches of Zanzibar. Does that sound good to you too?

blocks.orig: Whether you choose one of our popular Tanzania itineraries or prefer to customize your journey, we are here to assist you. Come aboard and get ready to explore Tanzania at your own pace, exactly the way you like it!
blocks.html: You can pick one of our popular Tanzania itineraries or have your journey tailored to you; either way, we are ready to help. Join us and get ready to discover Tanzania at your own pace, just the way you want it!

blocks.orig: As you walk out of Kilimanjaro International Airport, your personal Your Tanzania Trip guide greets you with a big smile: 'Karibu Tanzania - welcome to Tanzania!' The guide takes you straight to your hotel, where you can relax and take in the African atmosphere. The next day your guide takes you on an exclusive, private safari that allows you to travel at your own pace. Enjoy the luxury of your own safari jeep and take the liberty to stop and watch the animals as long as you like!
blocks.html: When you step out of Kilimanjaro International Airport, your own Your Tanzania Trip guide welcomes you with a broad smile: 'Karibu Tanzania - welcome to Tanzania!' Your guide drives you directly to your hotel, so you can unwind and soak up the African atmosphere. On the following day your guide sets off with you on an exclusive, private safari where you decide the pace. You have the luxury of a safari jeep of your own, and you are free to stop and look at the animals for as long as you want!

blocks.orig: Today is a wonderful relaxing day, that you can spend in whatever way you like. Choose to spend the whole day at the lodge to enjoy the excellent service, sip on refreshing drinks, lounge near the pool, and just engulf yourself in the African vibes surrounding you. Or get to know Arusha through some interesting activities - go for example on a city tour, explore the outskirts of the city by mountain bike, or score your first souvenirs at an exhilarating Maasai market…
blocks.html: This is a lovely, relaxed day that you can fill exactly as you wish. You might stay at the lodge all day to make the most of the excellent service, sip a cool drink, lie by the pool and simply soak up the African atmosphere around you. Or you might get to know Arusha with a few interesting activities, such as a city tour, a mountain bike ride through the outskirts of town, or hunting for your first souvenirs at a lively Maasai market…

blocks.orig: Today you will go for your first actual game drive, in Arusha National Park! This park close to Arusha is known for its abundance of tropical birds, the presence of the black and white Colobus monkey and some rare albino baboons. You will probably spot the Colobus monkey and some rare bird species such as the gorgeous Silvery Cheeked Hornbill, and, if you are very lucky, even an albino. The park also has a lake, a few craters, waterfalls, mountains, and beautiful grassy planes.
blocks.html: Your first real game drive takes place today, in Arusha National Park! Near Arusha, this park is famous for its many tropical birds, the black and white Colobus monkey and a few rare albino baboons. Chances are you will see the Colobus monkey and rare birds like the beautiful Silvery Cheeked Hornbill and, with a lot of luck, even an albino. You will also find a lake, several craters, waterfalls, mountains and lovely grassy plains in the park.

blocks.orig: Today you can relax at your hotel to enjoy the friendly service, or go out and about through a range of activities! You can for example visit the beautiful Mount Meru waterfalls. A short hike leads you there, after which you can take a refreshing swim in the cold water beneath the waterfall. Have your lunch in these quiet surroundings amidst singing birds and meandering water and try and spot the amazing Colobus monkey or the Silvery Cheeked Hornbill on your way back!
blocks.html: You can stay at your hotel today and enjoy the friendly service, or head out for one of a variety of activities! One option is a visit to the beautiful Mount Meru waterfalls. You reach them on a short hike, and afterwards you can cool off with a swim in the cold water below the falls. Eat your lunch in this peaceful spot surrounded by birdsong and flowing water, and on the way back keep an eye out for the remarkable Colobus monkey or the Silvery Cheeked Hornbill!

blocks.orig: Tarangire National Park is well known for its big groups of elephants and the huge amount of giant baobab trees. These trees can live for hundreds of years and are actually a source of water for elephants in the dry season as they have a special technique to draw water from them. Besides, the Tarangire River is the only source of water in the dry season, which is why in this season in Tarangire you can see groups of up to 250 elephants next to many more animals!
blocks.html: Tarangire National Park is famous for its large herds of elephants and its huge number of giant baobab trees. These trees can grow hundreds of years old, and in the dry season they even provide water for the elephants, which use a special technique to get water out of them. On top of that, the Tarangire River is the only water source during the dry season, so at that time of year you can see herds of up to 250 elephants in Tarangire, along with many other animals!

blocks.orig: Serengeti National Park is widely known as the place to go on safari, mainly because of the Great Migration that passes through here. The enormous, stampeding herds are impressive, as are the vast number of predators that live here: over four thousand lions, over 200 cheetahs, a thousand leopards, 3500 hyenas, and hundreds of wild dogs! And of course, plenty of other beautiful animals, which your guide will be delighted to search for together with you. Are you ready for this?
blocks.html: Serengeti National Park is known far and wide as the place for a safari, largely thanks to the Great Migration that moves through it. The huge, thundering herds are impressive, and so is the number of predators living here: more than four thousand lions, more than 200 cheetahs, a thousand leopards, 3500 hyenas and hundreds of wild dogs! Plus, of course, many other beautiful animals that your guide will be happy to look for with you. Are you ready?

blocks.orig: The famous Ngorongoro Crater is one of Africa's seven natural wonders. The crater was formed two million years ago when a vast volcano erupted. The fertile lava has created a unique ecosystem, now home to the highest concentration of animals found anywhere in Africa! Once in the crater, thousands of animals such as lions, zebras, buffalos and black rhinos surround you, and the views are astounding – you won’t know where to look!
blocks.html: The well-known Ngorongoro Crater counts as one of Africa's seven natural wonders. It came into being two million years ago, when a huge volcano erupted. The fertile lava gave rise to a unique ecosystem that now has the highest density of animals anywhere in Africa! Inside the crater you are surrounded by thousands of animals, including lions, zebras, buffalos and black rhinos, and the views are amazing – you won’t know which way to look!

blocks.orig: Today you fly to the spice island of Zanzibar. Our guide picks you up at the airport and takes you to your hotel. Over the next few days, you can discover white sandy beaches, crystal-clear turquoise waters and vibrant coral reefs. Into culture? Then head to Stone Town and dive into the history of this fascinating little town. Food lovers can also visit the spice plantations and discover the diverse flavours of the delicious local cuisine. A tropical paradise awaits you!
blocks.html: Today you take a flight to Zanzibar, the spice island. At the airport our guide collects you and drives you to your hotel. In the days that follow you can explore white sandy beaches, crystal-clear turquoise water and colourful coral reefs. Interested in culture? Then go to Stone Town and immerse yourself in the history of this fascinating small town. If you love food, you can also visit the spice plantations and taste the varied flavours of the delicious local cooking. A tropical paradise is waiting for you!

blocks.orig: Ultimate paradise is here: gorgeous, tropical Zanzibar! The clear blue waters of the Indian Ocean and the palm-fringed, white sandy beaches are almost too beautiful to be true. Buy your coconut drink fresh on the beach, spend hours sunbathing or swimming, and taste the delicious Zanzibari food. In the mood for something active? Then explore the beach, ocean, and island through a range of activities! We highly recommend the Safari Blue Cruise or a tour of Stone Town.
blocks.html: This is paradise at its best: beautiful, tropical Zanzibar! The clear blue Indian Ocean and the white sandy beaches lined with palm trees seem almost too beautiful to be real. Get a fresh coconut drink on the beach, sunbathe or swim for hours, and try the delicious Zanzibari cuisine. Feel like being active? Then discover the beach, the ocean and the island with a variety of activities! We warmly recommend the Safari Blue Cruise or a Stone Town tour.

blocks.orig: The last day! Depending on your flight time, you can relax on the beach or explore the island just a little bit more. Then, make your way to Zanzibar International Airport in time for your flight home. Having second thoughts? It's also possible to extend your holiday to another paradise island, such as Mnemba, Pemba, or Mafia!
blocks.html: Your final day! Depending on when your flight leaves, you can unwind on the beach or see a little more of the island. After that, head to Zanzibar International Airport in time for your flight home. Not ready to leave? You can also stretch your holiday with a stay on another tropical island, such as Mnemba, Pemba or Mafia!
